entry.name: filepath
entry.digest: Manage and report on the Max search path
entry.description: Provides access to the Max search path, and allows modification to the search path used by a patch.

arguments.name: path-type
arguments.description: Specifies one of the Max search path types (,,,, or)

arguments.name: preference
arguments.description: A number greater than zero specifies a slot in the Preferences file. If the argument isor no number is supplied, the path will not be saved in the Preferences file.

messages.name: append
messages.digest: Add a folder to a path
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol which specifies a folder, adds the folder to the list of paths (but does not save it in the Preferences file). An optional integer subfolder flag will also add any subfolders when set to 1.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: causes the currently saved path name(s) to be output as a list.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: This method is obsolete. Currently, it has no effect.

messages.name: revert
messages.digest: Revert to the saved path contents
messages.description: Causes the pathnames to be reset to the last set of Max file preferences to be saved.

messages.name: set
messages.description: The word, followed by the name of a Max search path type (,,,, or), sets the current search path to the type specified. An optional integer subfolder flag will also add any subfolders when set to 1.

inlets.digest: set Changes Path, append Adds Path
